messages:
Sam Nguyen: Quick sync — owners for the cutover traffic slices and SDK patch? Proposed timeline: Phase 1 canary next Tue, Phase 2 full cutover in ~3 weeks. Who owns endpoint gating, SDK headers bump, and docs?
Maria Patel: I can own the SDK patch (py + ts). Will draft PRs this week. Ping @Devon for gateway/header checks.
Devon Brooks: I’ll take proxy header negotiation. Need to confirm header fallback for old clients. Quick checklist: 1) proxy accepts X-Client-Version, 2) routing policy respects legacy param. Canary timeline looks OK but we need eng-infra load slots.
Olivia Chen: Eng-infra has a canary window Tue 10:00–12:00 UTC. I can add load tests to the harness. Need exact traffic slices (percentages) to schedule.
Sam Nguyen: Traffic slices: canary 0.5% -> 1% for 2h, then 5% for 6h if stable. Staged ramps to full cutover. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/cutover/patch-plan.md. Also need rollback playbook + smoke tests.
Jamal Ortiz: I’ll own the rollback playbook and monitoring alerts. Will add runbook for on-call. Suggested alert thresholds: latency + service error rate + 4xx spike. Drafting now.
    
sdk-ci: Build succeeded for sdk/py@patch-v2.0.1 — tests: 128 passed, 2 flaky (rerun queued). Details: https://ci.redwood/s/3421
Maria Patel: Will add header compatibility tests to SDK and update changelog. Draft PR here: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/451
Devon Brooks: Infra config snippet to add to proxy (will open PR):
```
headers:
  allow:
    - "X-Client-Version"
  fallback: true
```
Will add unit + integ tests for header fallback.
Olivia Chen: Noted — reserving canary slot. Also checking k8s rollout windows for any datastore migrations — any DB changes?
Sam Nguyen: No DB schema changes in this patch. Only config + header bump + SDK version. We still need OpenAPI update and mapping for versioned endpoints.
Jamal Ortiz: Ops schedule: canary runbook + two on-call engineers for first 4h. @Olivia can you confirm staffing?
Olivia Chen: Confirmed. I’ll add two on-call shifts to the rota and update the calendar invite.
Sam Nguyen: Next actions summary: Maria — finalize SDK PR by EOD Thu. Devon — infra/proxy PR + tests by Mon. Jamal — runbook draft by Mon. Olivia — reserve slots + update infra schedule. I’ll collate and produce final cutover checklist on Friday.
Maria Patel: ack :thumbsup: 
Devon Brooks: ack :eyes: 
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-group-3 -> Tue 10:00 UTC. Rolling update window 2h.
Sam Nguyen: Great — thanks everyone. If blockers surface tag #v2-cutover and ping here. End of thread.
